questions.question: Trust over time: after you have allowed the same high-risk tool several times (say three exact Allows for `scheduler.create_job`), should the card start offering a broader remember option for that tool ('Allow all scheduler job creations'), or should high-risk actions always stay exact-only?

Confirming the spec wording for the destructive ruling: `rm -rf build` asks once; Allow remembers that exact command and target; the identical command never asks again; `rm -rf dist` asks. Is that the behaviour you want?
